# Integrating SPIRE federation with multi-cluster {{ SMProductName }} {#zero-trust-manager-mesh-integration-multi-cluster}

Configure {{ spire_full }} (SPIRE) federation across multiple OpenShift Container Platform clusters to enable cross-cluster mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication and zero trust workload identity in a multi-cluster service mesh deployment.
